Read-only original-wave diagnostics41280306194 and41280275014 passed7 frozen-reader,13 event and8 transfer controls plus an authenticated actual-topology preflight. q15 A->AD had127 source transitions but only22 matched buffer crossings within the bounded125ps window; C->CD had128/14. The respective sampler-to-base median observed matched delays were61.9468ps and68.6585ps. These are diagnostic correlations, not proof that changing resistance fixes the circuit. Full35-file proofs031a9d3d6554b1574f4ba609279d3543cff03b8e and3266bcfca451cc2e8c06ac372409f1dbb240fb04 retain all events and original metrics.

Current at3mA per emitter remains a failure. Original distributed wire RC is retained for exploratory comparison; this is not fresh PEX or regenerated layout.

Run source controls first, preserve their complete proof, then independently reserve an empty exact-source release for one actual native run. # Loaded sampler operating-point diagnosis

Two read-only GitHub diagnoses reproduce the entire original native result and add simultaneous operating points:

| Native case | Diagnostic run | Diagnostic source | Full 29-file proof |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rejected24-resistor master/buffer | 41277766243 | 84d7f18fa89ac715ee242d17cd2dfdbeb51dce14 | 5fa4b869e7b10c5ceedd5265ec1ffc4561a8e1e9 |
| Rejected16-resistor q20 | 41278288991 | bb6ab5d1aa4a9e4b796ba8db40069d9d4902da61 | d0d1c4a8441ce8bb85997bd73e45eb87f66bd93e |

Each passed7frozen-reader and13event/operating-point controls. All124HBT metrics, all6stages and1530bit delays, phase and VI values reproduce the complete original report. All109 native archive members are verified on a GitHub runner. No simulation, stimulus change, geometry mutation or local native download occurs. Current equality at3mA/emitter remains a failure.

For each stage, the full result records all124HBT C/B/E/S voltages and collector currents at two common times: the original deadline for the worst-delay bit and the worst original sampled margin. The same interpolation time is used throughout a snapshot; finite vectors, strictly increasing time and in-capture interpolation are required. These simultaneous observations avoid combining unrelated extrema.

## Observations

In q20, at the X deadline for bit229 (30.7625ns), samplerA is2.235964/1.997223V and samplerC is2.007809/2.190464V. The following AD nodes are1.780820/1.903942V and CD nodes1.805119/1.857308V; S0 nodes are1.183484/1.196722V. X signed margin is-0.116870mV and Y signed margin2.614882mV at their75ps deadline.

At bit255's X sample (34.0125ns), q20 A is1.993740/2.240795V, C2.214440/1.981057V, AD2.017691/1.660620V, CD1.997915/1.658660V, and X signed margin-115.284513mV. These are measured voltages at one time, not a demonstrated causal model or proposed fix.

Static inspection of the authenticated candidate composition identifies separate divider networks:
* AQP cluster88 throughR227 L3.6um/W1 to cluster139 (Q123 base), withR228 L21.6um/W1 toavss and MIM273 3.6x3.6um acrossR227.
* AQN cluster87 similarly usesR229/R230/MIM274 toQ125 base cluster140.
* CQP cluster118 usesR238/R239/MIM277 toQ128 base cluster152.
* CQN cluster117 usesR240/R241/MIM278 toQ130 base cluster153.

All four buffer HBTs haveNx2, le.9um/we.07um. They are not directly connected input bases; divider and feedforward dynamics must be examined together with HBT loading. A output clusters87/88 also connect hold pair87/88, data pair89/91 and follower bases121/124, allNx4. This fanout is relevant to the unresolved A delay. Complete primitive records and simultaneous currents remain in the proofs.

In q15, Q89/91 maximum recorded current per emitter is about2.115mA, withNx4; Q123/125 about1.223/1.263mA, Q128/130 about1.083/1.095mA, withNx2. These are the existing device extrema. They do not predict current after resizing or certify a safe operating area.

The public IHP [npn13G2 PCell source](https://github.com/IHP-GmbH/IHP-Open-PDK/blob/main/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/klayout/python/sg13g2_pycell_lib/ihp/npn13G2_code.py) exposes Nx from1to10 and fixed default le/we. It also annotates collector-current limits by voltage. Any sizing change must be checked against the actual pinned PDK/model and operating envelope; the current nominal screening gate alone is not production approval. No change of emitter count, divider or capacitor has been implemented by this diagnosis.

## Corrected selector identity

The initial transfer analysis incorrectly assigned the S0/S1 divider input to B. The authenticated native composition instead binds DQP/DQN clusters18/17 throughR234/R236 to bases150/151, shared byQ131/Q149 andQ132/Q150. The topology guard refused the wrong assumption. See [actual transfer topology](cdr-sampler-transfer-topology.md) for full failure proofs and the corrected preflight.

## Next bounded work

Use the preserved full wave and complete composition to quantify transfer from A/C/D outputs into the divider bases and buffered AD/CD/S0/S1 nodes at the failing deadlines. Separate sampler delay from downstream settling. Qualify a controlled edit to the identified path only after confirming its complete native identity, current/voltage constraints and model support. Keep all original external load, source, timing and voltage gates.

# Actual retimed-D selector topology and loaded transfer diagnosis

The initial q20 run41279373178/source2aea08e3421f8bcf6d8a6e8adaf783cc6ea7082f and q15 run41279400555/sourcec421cc577281d78441fd51c6db160020e990a62c failed after reproducing the original electrical metrics. Their transfer analysis assumed B directly drove the selector dividers. The real topology guard rejected that assumption; this is an analysis failure, not a passing circuit result.

Complete31-file failure proofs are retained:
* q20:9aceb9e54839bc2c213aa1156c89da75a752b0d1, docs/evidence/cdr-sampler-candidate-wave-41279373178.
* q15:1992e4d33a5871e498282e7a1557c0cced73ee12, docs/evidence/cdr-sampler-candidate-wave-41279400555.

The authenticated candidate composition establishes:
* DQP native cluster18 through R234 L6um/W1 to receiver base cluster150; R235 L8.6um/W1 shunts to avss cluster23; MIM2754.8x4.8um parallels R234.
* DQN cluster17 through R236 L6um/W1 to base151; shuntR237 L8.6um/W1 and parallel MIM2764.8x4.8um.
* Q131/Q149 bases share150, Q132/Q150 share151. The positive S0/S1 outputs are Q132/Q150 collectors, negatives Q131/Q149.
* These selectors therefore receive retimed D, not B directly. Existing q15 B passing its original screen does not establish valid selector drive because D fails.

Corrected diagnosis retains A->AD and C->CD and uses D->S0/D->S1. It records A->C and B->D observed crossings plus expected-sequence lags to expose retimer behavior. Before native archive acquisition, a separate source-controls job verifies the actual full500-device composition and all four paths against authenticated original measurements. The archive job requires that successful preflight and later checks extracted composition equality. Seven frozen-reader, thirteen operating-point and eight transfer controls protect the interpretation.

Diagnostic50mV sampler/buffer and10mV base hysteresis identify observable transitions. Matching is bounded by the next input transition and125ps; missing, ambiguous and nearby outside-window events remain recorded. These thresholds never replace the original100mV/37.5ps sampler and100mV/75ps XOR gates. Expected pipeline lag is recorded separately; a crossing match alone does not establish protocol or timing correctness.

No circuit or layout mutation has been made by this read-only diagnosis. All native archives/waves/models remain on GitHub; local source/API-derived text coordination is temporary RAM only. Full serial PHY and final chip timing remain open.

## Completed corrected diagnoses

Both corrected runs succeeded: q20 run41280275014/sourcea487ebb6213d2e40bbdbac997f6624bf8cfa6afb and q15 run41280306194/sourceb1ef7227f2b828072722cd7bae0501f59494e18f. Each passed7 frozen-reader,13 operating-point and8 transfer controls and the actual-topology preflight. All124HBT metrics, six stages,1530 original bit delays and phase/VI values reproduce the original report. Their complete35-file proofs are3266bcfca451cc2e8c06ac372409f1dbb240fb04 and031a9d3d6554b1574f4ba609279d3543cff03b8e.

| Path | q15 source transitions | q15 matched sampler->buffer | q15 missing in window | q20 source transitions | q20 matched | q20 missing |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| A->AD |127|22|105|127|18|109|
| C->CD |128|14|114|128|14|114|
| D->S0 |128|14|114|128|12|116|
| D->S1 |128|14|114|128|12|116|

No ambiguous matches occurred. q15 median matched sampler-to-base delays are61.9468ps(A),68.6585ps(C),61.7180ps(D->S0) and61.9117ps(D->S1). A base-to-buffer median is58.2426ps and C51.8529ps. These medians use different matched subsets and must not be added to infer a complete path delay. Missing-in-window means no same-direction confirmed crossing under the diagnostic matching rule, not a measured packet bit error.

B->D has128/128 matching crossings and no missing events in both candidates; q15 median65.88095ps, q20 median66.13516ps. B and D expected arrays have index lag0 because B uses the falling edge and D the rising edge. A->C expected arrays have index lag1; its approximately122ps matched delays sit near the125ps window boundary. q15 has62 matched/65 outside-or-missing, q20 has54/73. These retimer observations do not override the original100mV validity failures and window-boundary exclusions are not by themselves lost pipeline data.

## Next circuit experiment

The next controlled hypothesis reduces the eight A/C divider lengths while preserving their geometric series/shunt ratio: R227/229/238/2403.6->1.8um andR228/230/239/24121.6->10.8um, allW1um, retaining the earlier q15 sixteen length changes. D selectors, capacitors, HBT sizes and the original native workload/gates remain unchanged. This produces a distinct24-target candidate; it is not the earlier24-resistor master/buffer experiment.

Lower impedance may reduce base settling delay, but can increase sampler loading and shift loaded bias because of base current and contact effects. Only actual unchanged-gate simulation can accept or reject the hypothesis. It is not an accepted physical change; a new physical map and fresh DRC/LVS/RC are required after any passing intrinsic result.
